Name: Pierre's Balcony
Author: OceanSmith
Description:
I always found it strange that the top floor balcony of Pierre's shop could not be accessed by the player. This mod aims to fix that by adding a staircase in the bottom of Pierre's shop which leads up to the balcony.

This mod should be compatible with everything that does not modify the main exterior of Pierre's shop or the bottom left corner of the interior of the shop (see mod images).

Downloads.Description: Fixed the NPC pathfinding bug, this new version requires TMXL and PyTK as a result

Manifest.Name: Pierre's Balcony
Manifest.Description: Makes Pierre's balcony accessible by a staircase in the shop
